question: If I activate Aura swap and the only Aura in my hand cannot enchant that permanent, does half of the exchange still happen?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if half the exchange cannot be completed on resolution, nothing happens.
expected.answer: If on resolution, half the exchange can’t be completed (such as if the only Aura in your hand can’t enchant the permanent), nothing happens.
